name: Grouped-query attention
change: Query heads are split into groups; each group shares one key and value head, so only H_kv < H heads are cached.
problem_solved: KV memory grew with every attention head. Sharing K/V across a group shrinks the cache by H / H_kv with little quality loss.
trade_off: Fewer KV heads can cost some quality; the cache still grows linearly in every layer.
kv_formula: 2 × L × H_kv × d_head × b per token

reference.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models from Multi-Head Checkpoints
